author: marketing_c
protectedRevelations: Publication compiler design, governance implementation and detailed transition plan

scenes.title: The experiment after the paper
scenes.viewerPurpose: Make the distinctive idea or tension understandable on first hearing. Introduce the book-specific proposal clearly and leave its fuller explanation for reading. Notice code choices and failures beneath a single claim
scenes.composition: A paper keeps its claim attached to code, data and laboratory notes
addOrChange: Add one directly connected claim rather than a large decorative knowledge graph.

cues.narration: What if a research book kept its claims connected to the experiments, code, and mistakes behind them?
cues.visualAction: Follow one claim to the experiment, code and recorded mistake behind it.

cues.narration: The Living Research Book proposes that kind of publication, with a record that can grow as researchers learn.
cues.visualAction: Update the connected record while keeping the earlier reason available.

cues.narration: A claim depends on data, code, decisions, and sometimes a failed approach that never reached the article.
cues.visualAction: Open a failed approach beside the code and dataset.

scenes.title: A larger record
scenes.viewerPurpose: Understand the proposed living research record Want to follow a readable account down to evidence
scenes.composition: One claim remains attached to its data and code
addOrChange: Use only necessary links and add separate reader and reviewer positions.

cues.narration: The book proposes keeping those connections alive as a research project changes.
cues.visualAction: Change one research item while preserving its connection to the claim.

cues.narration: Readers could follow an explanation while reviewers inspect the evidence beneath it.
cues.visualAction: A reader follows the explanation as a reviewer opens its evidence.

scenes.title: Change without losing the past
scenes.viewerPurpose: Know earlier versions would still be available See AI as useful but capable of persuasive mistakes Distinguish keeping files from checking a claim
scenes.composition: Two dated editions remain beside a working copy
addOrChange: Add an unresolved evidence note instead of automatic AI approval.

cues.narration: Older versions would still be available to cite when a new version appears.
cues.visualAction: Bring the newer edition forward while the older stays available.

cues.narration: AI could help readers find their way, but it could also make mistakes sound convincing.
cues.visualAction: Place a fluent AI suggestion beside the unresolved evidence note.

cues.narration: Keeping more files does not, by itself, make a claim easier to check.
cues.visualAction: The reviewer checks the evidence rather than the number of files.

scenes.title: Publication as a living question
scenes.viewerPurpose: Imagine no longer rebuilding context every time Ask what should remain when understanding changes
scenes.composition: Reader and researcher share a record of one changed claim
addOrChange: Add the two people and keep the old reason accessible.

cues.narration: Could researchers and readers stop having to piece the same story back together?
cues.visualAction: Both locate the same earlier decision in the shared record.

cues.narration: What should survive when a research team’s understanding changes?
cues.visualAction: Hold the previous reason beside the revised interpretation.

checks: This is an unexecuted production plan; inspect the resulting film after implementation before declaring animation complete.

Keep one short scene title, clear space for the complete subtitle sentence, and restrained motivated movement; no duplicate headings or decorative lines.
Retain source-specific objects only where they explain this sentence; remove the listed actors and retire their obsolete actions and connections.
Check Color, Light and Dark with flat backgrounds, readable display headings and captions, no nested frames, cast shadows or theatrical spectacle.
Check plot setup against the source and preserve the recorded protected revelations; diagrams illustrate proposals and do not certify unproven technology.
Validate all action targets and measured beat references after replacement; compare first, middle and last frames at desktop and phone sizes with muted playback.
